snippet.title: SAMSON | Console Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Samson: A Tyndalston Story is out September 21, 2026 on XBOX Series S | X and PS5. 

Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is ticking. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.

Samson is already out on Steam and Epic Games Store, and we will drop our biggest update yet as we release on console.

Play on Steam now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634520
Play on Epic Games Store now: https://store.epicgames.com/p/samson-ab5af7

SAMSON is developed and published by Liquid Swords.

Social Links: 
Website: https://thesamson.com 
Discord server: https://discord.gg/xPHpQgKUwG
